kitDescription: Alice is a Fire SR Attacker (Burst III) whose whole identity is charged shots. When the team enters Full Burst, she grants the two allies with the highest final ATK a 10-second Charge Speed (+11.67%) and Charge Damage (+7%) boost. Her own burst is a self-buff that dramatically shortens her charge time (Charge Speed +80.15%) and raises her ATK (+55.12%) for 10 seconds, letting her fire many faster, harder-hitting charged shots. She also has an HP-gated self passive: continuous Pierce while above 80% HP, switching to self-healing (recover 8.12% of attack damage) if she drops below 80%. At scope lock the Pierce is damage-inert (partless boss, no pierce-damage carrier) and the lifesteal branch never triggers (boss deals no damage), so her effective contribution is the FB-enter ally charge buffs plus her own burst cadence/ATK lift.

verdictRationale: All six kit lines are FAITHFUL (five load-bearing) or a recorded DOCUMENTED_GAP (the unreachable <80% lifesteal), so faithfulness is 1.0 with zero REAL-GOTCHAs. The S5 blind tests materialize GREEN against the shipped override (6 pass + 4 skip), and both blind writers (S5/S6, cross-family opus) independently re-derived the driver's exact structure — fullBurstEnter + top-2 final-ATK self-inclusive for S1, burstCast self for the burst, pierce-as-tag-inert, lifesteal-unmodeled. The ONLY blind divergences were stat-key guesses forced by the redacted StatKey enum (attackSpeedPct-for-charge-speed, chargeDamageMultPct-for-charge-damage, alliesHighestAtk kind-name) — every one ⚑-flagged by the blind writers and every one resolved to the driver's engine-verified keys (chargeSpeedPct sim.ts:2557, chargeDamagePct sim.ts:1385 — correctly the additive bucket not the base-charge scaler, alliesTopAtk+byFinalAtk). These are RECON_ERROR artifacts of redaction, not gotchas. Discrimination holds: A1/A2/B1/C1/C2 each fail under their named nearest-wrong model (burstCast↔fullBurstEnter keying, top-2↔all-allies, pierce-tag↔pierceDamagePct-buff). The same-model residual the owner should spot-check is measurement-gated and out of gauntlet scope: (1) the caster-relative '11.67% of the skill user's Charge Speed' qualifier modeled as a plain +11.67% (no caster-relative StatKey, small magnitude); (2) the effective charge cadence produced by the 80.15% Charge Speed against datamined chargeFrames 90 / reloadFrames 141 / ammo 6 — pin from footage before trusting the charge-driven damage number; (3) the 80.15%+11.67% stacking convention (additive-in-stat vs multiplicative on charge time) when alice self-includes in her own S1. Board reads 1.101 HOT (1 record); the residual is attributed to basis/comp-side, not a kit-encoding defect. GO.
